data: Binance public monthly Spot 1m klines, SHA256 checksum required; unavailable files recorded, not substituted; reset warmup each month
engines: PreExplosionEngine BUY plus EntryGuard unchanged, and prior-12-bar resistance entry range [0.1%,0.6%]
unevaluable: Hybrid ranking and real quote stability/spread
entry: open two bars after signal bar (one minute delay after close); stress open four bars after signal (three minutes delay)
exit: open 60 minutes after entry; no optimized stop or target; no overlapping signals within 6h per symbol per variant
baseline: 20 deterministic seeded uniform random valid entry times in the same symbol-month per signal, same duration/cost/delay; equal per-observation weight, not portfolio return; overlaps possible
bootstrap: 2000 resamples of pooled symbol-month clusters; 97.5% two-sided interval (Bonferroni for two variants); seed 20261024
acceptance: each of validation and confirmation requires >=100 signals, >=6 distinct months, lower clustered interval of mean net and mean excess over random >0, mean stressed net >0, and stressed excess >0; confirmation is retrospective and insufficient for production enablement
missing: all signal rows retained; incomplete forward 64-minute path marked missing; no negative/positive outcome substitution
events: nonoverlapping by 60 minutes: first future close at least +2% from candidate minute close within 60 min; signal in previous 15 min or at event start counts detected; all gaps excluded and counted; fixed definition, not all pumps
limitations: fixed seven-symbol panel is not all-market representative or free of selection bias; exclude no losses; historical periods may be familiar from prior daily research; no microstructure fill claims; no thresholds may be changed after results
daily_momentum: separate strategy: rerun existing frozen portfolio simulator on previously archived broad daily universe through 2026-10-16; retain separate summary and label reused periods, not new independent evidence
deployment: BUY alerts default research-disabled until genuine prospective validation; no ranking/threshold additions; keep one primary minute research engine; unavailable components labelled not evaluated rather than failed
